title: Offline and Native Durability
l2_summary: Provides full offline capability and native mobile integration for TakeoffPro. Offline durability is achieved through a layered stack: IndexedDB (takeoffpro-offline v2, 13 stores) mirrors 8 Supabase tables via mirrorProject; all writes flow through a single mutate() path that applies an optimistic IDB update and enqueues to a durable outbox when offline; a sync loop drains the outbox with 4 parallel workers (per-row serial ordering) and exponential backoff (1s→4s→15s→60s→180s, max 5 attempts). Plan PDFs are cached in CacheStorage pdf-cache-v1 with 500 MB LRU eviction tracked in IDB. The PWA layer registers a Workbox service worker on web and gates registration behind Capacitor.isNativePlatform() to prevent double registration on iOS/Android. The Capacitor native shell wraps geolocation, camera, biometric auth (FaceID/TouchID), filesystem export, push notifications, and background-sync via appStateChange. Platform detection is centralised in src/lib/native/platform.ts. TanStack Query cache is persisted to IDB via idb-persister.ts. UI surfaces include an offline pill, install CTA, update-available toast (PwaShell), outbox queue inspector with per-item retry (SyncPanel), biometric gate (BiometricGate), and native first-run onboarding (NativeFirstRun).

status_by_criterion.AC1_offline_serve: partial — mirrorProject snapshots 8 tables but daily_reports is hard-capped at 30 rows, silently truncating older history for offline inspectors
status_by_criterion.AC2_optimistic_idb: implemented — mutate() writes _pendingSync:true to IDB before enqueue
status_by_criterion.AC3_serial_per_row_4_workers: implemented — drainOnce groups by rowId, runs up to 4 concurrent row-groups serially
status_by_criterion.AC5_capacitor_no_sw: implemented — shouldRegisterSW() returns false when Capacitor.isNativePlatform()
status_by_criterion.AC6_pwa_update_toast: implemented — registerSWWithUpdates uses Workbox; PwaShell wires setReloadFn on waiting event
status_by_criterion.AC7_pdf_cache: implemented — warmPdf stores in pdf-cache-v1; evictIfNeeded enforces 500 MB LRU cap

surfaces.role: IDB persistence — opens takeoffpro-offline v2, 13 stores, CRUD helpers
Snapshots 8 Supabase tables into IDB; mirrorProjectList for project list
Durable outbox — enqueue/list/count/update/remove + blob store + subscribeOutbox
Online-first mutate() with optimistic IDB mirror and outbox fallback; runDirect
triggerSync / startSyncLoop — 4-worker drain, serial per-row, exponential backoff
warmPdf / getCachedPdf — CacheStorage pdf-cache-v1, 500 MB LRU via IDB metadata
Offline pill, install CTA, update-available toast
Outbox queue status UI with per-item retry

risks_and_debt.description: daily_reports mirrored at 30-row cap — inspectors reviewing older history offline see silent data gaps
No conflict resolution UI — OutboxStatus includes 'conflict' but mutation-client never sets it; conflicts silently land in 'failed'
IDB schema v2 has no forward migration path — getDB only handles oldVersion < 1 and < 2; v3 upgrade risks data loss
jsPDF.save() bypasses warmPdf — generated PDFs are not cacheable and will be unavailable offline

serves_inbound: all streams (annotations, daily reports, calibrations, pay items, schedule activities) via mutate()
feeds_outbound: schedule-management reads schedule_activities IDB store offline
